stem.text: Q is a mixture of a Group 2 oxide and a Group 2 sulfate. Q contains equal amounts of the two compounds.

Q is shaken with water and the resulting mixture filtered; a solid residue is obtained. There is no reaction when the solid residue is shaken with $\text{HCl(aq)}$. Shaking the filtrate with $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4\text{(aq)}$ produces a white precipitate.
